title: Original GQ source-anchor dirty-pencil identity and uniform marginal
statement: For genuine W(3,s), fixed arbitrary complete globally injected f,g: D_left=s*sum_q t_f(q) and D_right=s*sum_r t_g(r), each <=2*s*(a-2)*V. For uniformly chosen original nonincident (q,r), P(anchor end-dirty)<=min(1,4*(a-2)/(s*(s+1)))=O(s^-1/2). Probability is over original nonincident endpoint pairs, not over f,g or a conditioned physical-template law.

quantifiers.domain: complete globally injected original point and line physical-edge maps

external_dependencies: Genuine GQ uniqueness and source-pencil combinatorics from pinned EICE-003-K proof.
limitations: Does not prove conditioned four-correlated-anchor capacity C_e=o(s^4).
Does not transfer clean-anchor marginal to an accepted original GF5 sixset.
Does not establish Branch A or B.
falsification_boundary: Uniformly sampled original nonincident pairs are a different probability measure than source-conditioned I1/J physical five-incidence templates.
